---
name: run-validity
description: Judges whether a recorded eval run counts.
---
Run run-validity.py on a recorded run before you grade it. It reads the run's transcript
and metadata file and prints one verdict line per run, the grader's first input.
- run-validity.py judges that the run finished.
- run-validity.py judges that every grader ran.
- run-validity.py judges that the run used the pinned model.
- run-validity.py judges that the run's seed is recorded.
